rows.description: Parses and writes .sln/.slnx solutions and .vbproj files, builds VB.NET symbol trees with a recursive descent parser, maps compiled assemblies by reflection and decodes IL and source maps for sciBASIC# code tooling.
Reads both classic MSF and Portable PDB debug symbol files, decoding source documents, sequence points, line numbers, public symbols and type records into one uniform model for sciBASIC# tooling.

Extends BinaryReader and BinaryWriter with endianness-aware primitives, length-prefixed strings, BZip2/LZW compression, XDR encoding and a Python pickle codec, for parsing custom binary file formats in sciBASIC#.
rows.tags: scibasic binary-data binary-reader endianness compression pickle

rows.description: Linear, polynomial, weighted and non-negative least squares, MLR, LOESS/LOWESS local regression, logistic, LASSO and Levenberg-Marquardt fitting with Bayesian and Gauss-Newton solvers. Part of sciBASIC#.
rows.tags: scibasic curve-fitting regression lasso loess levenberg-marquardt

rows.description: A charting engine for sciBASIC# that renders scatter, line, bar, histogram, box, violin, contour, heatmap, pie, radar, treemap, Venn and 3D plots with configurable axes, legends and themes.
rows.tags: scibasic chart plotting data-visualization gdi-plus graphics

rows.description: Adds statistical graphics to the sciBASIC# chart engine: ROC and QQ plots, forest and Z-score plots, correlation heatmaps and triangles, density plots, time trends, PCA scree plots and regression plots.
rows.tags: scibasic statistics roc-curve heatmap qq-plot pca-plot

rows.description: Package Description

Core tabular data library for sciBASIC#: DataFrame and DataSet objects, CSV and ARFF readers/writers, MySQL helpers, and reflection based storage providers that map .NET classes to table rows and columns.
rows.tags: scibasic dataframe csv arff storage-provider tabular-data

rows.description: Extension helpers for the sciBASIC# data framework: streams CLR objects into DataTable, saves complex objects as multi-sheet Excel-like tables via outlining schemas, plus CSV template helpers.
rows.tags: scibasic dataframe extensions serialization datatable outlining

rows.description: Runs a piped graph query language over HTML/XML documents, combining CSS selectors, XPath expressions, attribute selectors and built-in functions to extract nodes, text and values and emit them as JSON.
rows.tags: scibasic graph-query html css-selector xpath json

rows.description: Algorithm library for sciBASIC# graphs: Dijkstra and A-star shortest paths, contraction hierarchies, Dinic max flow, Louvain, Leiden and label propagation communities, plus MST, Ullmann isomorphism and HNSW search.

Reads HDF5 files without native libraries by decoding superblocks, B-trees, object headers, symbol tables and global heaps, exposing groups, attributes, and contiguous, chunked or compact datasets to sciBASIC# code.
rows.tags: scibasic hdf5 scientific-data dataset binary-format reader

rows.description: Serializes and deserializes .NET objects to and from the MessagePack binary format, with reflection based member schemas, MessagePackMember attributes, nil implication handling and typed collection support.
rows.tags: scibasic msgpack messagepack serialization binary-format deserialization

rows.description: A pure managed parser for SQLite3 database files that decodes the database header, B-tree pages, master table and column types, exposes tables and rows, and parses CREATE TABLE schema SQL without the native SQLite engine.
rows.tags: scibasic sqlite3 database btree sql-parser reader

rows.description: NLP toolkit for sciBASIC#: Chinese word segmentation via max-match, HMM and a HuggingFace-compatible BPE/WordPiece/Unigram pipeline, plus a Porter stemmer, TF-IDF, BM25 ranked search and Gibbs-sampled LDA topic modeling.

Trains word embeddings for sciBASIC#: a multi-threaded Word2Vec using skip-gram and CBOW over Huffman trees, a fluent factory for vector size, window and sampling, plus vector models for similarity and analogy queries.
Reads and writes time-series signal collections with their metadata, chunk indices and measure units to netCDF files, interoperating with R-based signal analysis pipelines. Part of sciBASIC#.
rows.tags: scibasic signal-io netcdf time-series data-exchange file-format

rows.description: Reads SAS XPORT (XPT) transport files and ASN.1 encoded byte streams, and provides a binary frame reader/writer that persists sciBASIC# DataFrame objects with a typed column schema into a single seekable file.
rows.tags: scibasic data-storage sas-xport asn1 dataframe binary-serialization

rows.description: NLP module of sciBASIC#: TextRank keyword and key phrase extraction, PageRank based sentence scoring for automatic summarization, Brill part-of-speech tagging, and HTML article body extraction.
rows.tags: scibasic nlp textrank keyword-extraction summarization pos-tagging

rows.description: Visualization abstractions for sciBASIC#: correlation and K-means network graphs, binary tree layouts, 2D and 3D rendering of UMAP, SOM and other data embeddings, plus tabular CSV rendering helpers.
rows.tags: scibasic visualization network-graph embedding clustering umap

rows.description: Defines the NetworkGraph node and edge model with dynamic graph tables, and supplies community detection, shortest paths, degree and betweenness centrality. The data layer of the sciBASIC# network visualization stack.

Reads and writes network graphs as CSV, JSON and VB.NET table sets, and imports or exports Cytoscape, Gephi, GML, Sigma.js and graphology documents. The IO layer of the sciBASIC# network visualization stack.

Supplies force-directed, spring-embedder, constrained Cola, orthogonal, radial, circular, HOLA and edge-bundling layouts behind a common IPlanner interface. Computes node coordinates before rendering sciBASIC# networks.

Renders a laid-out NetworkGraph into bitmap or vector images, drawing nodes, edges, arrowheads, labels and convex-hull groups through a CSS-like map-expression language for colours, shapes and sizes in sciBASIC#.
Parses and writes RIFF/WAVE audio files with FMT and data sub-chunk access, and extracts mel-filterbank voiceprint vectors with delta coefficients, CMVN and L2 normalisation. Part of sciBASIC#.
rows.tags: scibasic wav audio voiceprint mfcc riff

rows.description: Clusters vector data by inserting items into an AVL binary tree under a fuzzy similarity comparison, then cutting the tree into partitions. Also offers Newick tree parsing, affinity propagation and KNN graph helpers.

Estimates local point density on 2D grids and KD-tree indexes, and segments images into compact superpixels with the SLIC algorithm. Useful for outlier detection and image region grouping in the sciBASIC# framework.

Dynamic programming kernels for sciBASIC#, including Needleman-Wunsch global alignment, Smith-Waterman local alignment with HSP chaining, k-banded search, center star multiple alignment and the 0-1 knapsack solver.

Encodes raw feature vectors of a data frame into numeric columns for model training: one-hot style encoding for enums and flag bit fields, numeric binning and discretisation, and automatic per-field encoder selection.

Data mining library for sciBASIC#: K-means, DBSCAN, HDBSCAN, OPTICS, fuzzy C-means and spectral clustering, Apriori association rules, decision trees, self-organizing maps and ROC or AUC model evaluation.

Implements hidden Markov models and Markov chains with forward, backward, Viterbi, Bayes and Baum-Welch EM algorithms, so you can score, decode and re-estimate state sequences from observation chains in sciBASIC#.

Agglomerative hierarchical clustering engine for sciBASIC#: the JBIRCH CF-tree for streaming data plus single, complete, average and weighted linkage strategies, distance maps and a reusable hierarchy tree builder.

Renders hierarchical clustering results as publication-ready graphics: vertical dendrograms, circular and radial layouts, and horizon or right-to-left panels, with class colour legends, leaf labels and rulers.

Uniform Manifold Approximation and Projection for sciBASIC#: builds a fuzzy simplicial set from k-nearest neighbours via NN-descent or KD-trees, then optimises a low-dimensional layout by stochastic gradient descent.

A VB.NET port of the Feather columnar file format, built on an embedded FlatBuffers runtime. Reads and writes typed and untyped data frames with row/column access, null handling, and categorical or timestamp metadata.
rows.tags: scibasic feather arrow columnar dataframe flatbuffers

rows.description: A packable virtual file system that stores many named streams, folders and attributes inside one binary file. Supports block allocation, buffered read/write, file deletion, metadata trees and read-only mounting for dataset archives.
rows.tags: scibasic hdspack virtual-filesystem stream-pack archive binary-format

rows.description: Reads and writes netCDF files for array oriented scientific data, handling dimensions, record dimensions, global and variable attributes, and typed data vectors over byte, short, integer, float and double.
rows.tags: scibasic netcdf scientific-data array-data dimensions variables

rows.description: Deep learning toolkit for sciBASIC#: a CeNiN CNN reader, trainable convolutional networks with SGD/AdaGrad/Adam trainers, character-level RNNs, Transformer attention models, and a general artificial neural network.

A Windows-only GDI+ canvas, image filter and font-metrics wrapper with converters that bridge sciBASIC# graphics models to System.Drawing. Keeps drawing code compatible across the System.Drawing and SkiaSharp back ends.

A driver-based drawing engine that renders charts, heatmaps, shapes, text and isometric 3D scenes to bitmap, SVG or PostScript output through one IGraphics API. It is the visualization core of sciBASIC#.

A dependency-free AVI (RIFF) writer that assembles main/stream headers and appends bitmap frames into a playable video file, ideal for exporting rendered animation frames from the sciBASIC# imaging pipeline.

Loads STL, OBJ, glTF/GLB, COLLADA, 3DS, 3MF and PLY meshes into one unified scene model, then converts the surfaces into voxel and signed-distance volumes for CFD simulation. Part of the sciBASIC# imaging stack.

A fixed-step 2D physics world with rigid bodies, broad and narrow phase collision, revolute, prismatic, spring and weld joints, force fields, SPH fluids and boids flocking, plus force-driven label placement for sciBASIC#.

Classical machine learning library for sciBASIC#: random forests, a LibSVM support vector machine port, genetic algorithms and differential evolution, Q-learning tables, activation functions and normalised sample datasets.

Helpers for sciBASIC# machine learning data: export a trained Q-table with state features to netCDF, record Q-value curves per iteration to CSV, and save or load labelled clustering matrices in a compact binary format.

Diagnostics helpers for sciBASIC# neural network training: builds demo sample sets, converts XML datasets to tabular rows, extracts fitness and neuron value frames from training netCDF logs, and computes ROC validation curves.

t-Distributed Stochastic Neighbor Embedding for sciBASIC#: converts pairwise affinities into joint probabilities at a given perplexity and minimises KL divergence, with a Barnes-Hut SPTree approximation for large data.

Self-contained tensor engine for sciBASIC#, not a Google TensorFlow binding: a managed multi-dimensional Tensor, a NumPy-style API, neural network activations and losses, and reverse-mode automatic differentiation.

Generative modelling library for sciBASIC#: a graph variational autoencoder with GCN encoder and inner-product decoder, a Gaussian mixture VAE with categorical latents, and an EM-trained Gaussian mixture model.

Gradient boosting toolkit for sciBASIC#: reads and scores XGBoost model files through GBTree, GBLinear and Dart boosters, and trains ternary gradient boosting trees with categorical and missing value handling.
Training data preparation for sciBASIC# XGBoost: two-pass CSV readers for test and validation tables, and converters building labelled TrainData with categorical columns and missing value indexes.

Core math for sciBASIC#: dense and sparse matrices, SVD and linear solvers, simplex linear programming, BigDecimal arithmetic, splines, quantiles, distributions, fuzzy logic and an expression scripting engine.
rows.tags: scibasic mathematics linear-algebra numerics linear-programming spline

rows.description: Immutable expression-tree computer algebra for sciBASIC#: derivatives, integrals, limits, Taylor expansion, polynomial factorisation, simplification, Boolean algebra and a MathML to LINQ expression compiler.
rows.tags: scibasic symbolic-math computer-algebra calculus mathml polynomial

rows.description: 2D curve and shape matching with Procrustes and Frechet distance, connected component labelling, Hough circle detection, text OCR, RANSAC point-set alignment and multi-object tracking. Part of sciBASIC#.
rows.tags: scibasic machine-vision shape-matching hough-transform connected-component tracking

rows.description: Labelled numeric matrix model with pairwise correlation and distance matrix builders, missing-value imputation, scaling and centering transforms, and Matrix Market MTX/RUA file IO. Part of sciBASIC#.
rows.tags: scibasic data-matrix correlation distance-matrix matrix-market imputation

rows.description: Integrates systems of ordinary differential equations with Euler, RK2, RK4, Gill and trapezoidal solvers over a declarative model of variables, parameters and initial values. Part of sciBASIC#.
rows.tags: scibasic ode runge-kutta dynamical-system numerical-integration simulation

rows.description: Random number generation for sciBASIC#: Mersenne Twister, a fast xorshift-style generator, a thread-safe wrapper and a table-driven RAND randomizer for normal deviates and Monte Carlo simulation.
rows.tags: scibasic random mersenne-twister monte-carlo pseudorandom sampling

rows.description: Algorithms for one-dimensional signals in sciBASIC#: FFT and wavelet transforms, Savitzky-Golay filtering, peak detection, baseline removal, resampling, DTW and COW alignment, plus Kalman filtering.
rows.tags: scibasic signal-processing fft wavelet peak-detection filtering

rows.description: Probability distributions, moment functions, hypothesis tests such as t-test, F-test, chi-square, Fisher exact, Mantel and Moran's I, plus FastICA, RANSAC and Shapley/TreeSHAP values. Part of sciBASIC#.
rows.tags: scibasic statistics hypothesis-testing distribution fastica shapley-value

rows.description: One-way ANOVA F-tests, Kruskal-Wallis non-parametric group comparison with FDR correction, and multivariate methods (PCA, PLS, OPLS-DA) for omics data. Part of the sciBASIC# scientific computing framework.
rows.tags: scibasic anova kruskal-wallis multivariate-analysis pca pls

rows.description: A JSON and BSON toolkit for sciBASIC#: a streaming JSON tokenizer and parser, a lenient parser that repairs malformed large language model output, plus BSON binary encoding and object serialization.

Supports the application/rdf+xml MIME type for sciBASIC#: XML serialization models for RDF descriptions, bags and DCMI metadata, plus a RDF 1.1 Turtle parser that streams subject-predicate-object triples.

XML helpers for sciBASIC#: an XSD element data model with VB.NET class code generation, MathML expression builders, a lightweight XPath query engine, and a generic XmlElement tree with reflection-based graph loading.

A professional HTML renderer for sciBASIC#: tokenizes HTML into a queryable DOM, parses CSS selectors and property values, lays out boxes, lines and tables, and paints the result onto a GDI+ graphics canvas.

XLSX Transitional Office Open XML support for sciBASIC#: reads an xlsx package into typed directory parts, sheets and styles, generates styled workbooks with formulas and number formats, and parses legacy BIFF files.

A markdown processor for sciBASIC#: parses CommonMark-style blocks and inline spans into a typed block model or JSON document, renders it to HTML or plain text, and generates nested tables of contents from ATX headers.

Parses YAML for the sciBASIC# framework into the JsonElement model with block mappings, sequences, flow collections, block scalars, anchors, aliases and comments, plus a lightweight markdown front-matter reader.

Runtime core of sciBASIC#: LINQ and collection extensions, reflection and dynamic native interop, text and tabular data handling, command line parsing, parallel helpers, application services and logging.
